claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu describes Taygetan quantum holographic computers as non-digital systems whose cores use millions of nanoparticle accelerators; their holograms can be tactile and provide sensory stimulation.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says she uses these systems daily but frames the video as entertainment.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says Taygetan ship computers can infer pilot intent through a thought interface, check anticipated reactions before acting, and allow manual controls to override the system.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says pilots and new ships perform best after becoming familiar with one another.

review_flags: The source begins by framing its claims as entertainment and describes unverified extraterrestrial computing technology.
coverage_gaps: The video also attributes time-field computation, cross-distance muon communication, and sentience to these computers.
